name: tunnelterm-vscode
description: Use an authenticated VS Code Remote Tunnel as an interactive local terminal.

tunnelterm.allowedRoots.description: Remote POSIX paths TunnelTerm may use for working directories and file transfer. Empty means the currently opened remote workspace folders.

tunnelterm.defaultCwd.description: Default remote working directory. Empty means the first remote workspace folder.

tunnelterm.shell.description: Remote POSIX shell command, for example /bin/bash. Empty uses the remote SHELL environment variable, then /bin/sh.

tunnelterm.maxTransferBytes.description: Maximum size of one uploaded/downloaded file and one captured stdout/stderr stream.

tunnelterm.requestPollMs.description: Local request queue polling interval in milliseconds.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: TunnelTerm can execute remote commands and is disabled until the workspace is trusted.

scripts.check: node --check bin/tunnelterm.mjs && node --check src/extension.cjs && python -m py_compile remote/tunnelterm_agent.py
